summary.result: Although the change in discomfort index was similar to the change in temperature overall, distinct differences in relative humidity by time and region were clear.
summary.background: For this purpose, we obtained AWS meteorological data (0:00, July 1, 2018 ~ 23:00, August 31, 2018.) from 17 sites in Seoul and used the raw data to calculate the Thomʹs discomfort index.
summary.method: According to this study, the discomfort index in Seoul was highest in the ‘Jungrang’ and ‘Seongdong’ areas from 15:00 to 17:00 in early August.
